description.zh: 显示返回结果中的第几页。最大取值为1000，默认值为1。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 1.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该**ID**值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无**实例概览**页面或**ID**值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the instance. You can view the ID of the instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.****

>*   If your instance has an ID, you must specify the ID for this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.****
>*   If no **Overview** page or **ID** is generated for your instance, you do not need to configure this parameter.

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大值为100，默认值为10。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

description.zh:
资源组ID。

><notice>目前，物联网平台仅支持实例维度的资源组管理。请求参数**ResourceGroupId**配置已无效，无需再传入。
></notice>
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the rule belongs. You can log on to the [Resource Management](https://resourcemanager.console.aliyun.com/resource-groups) console to view the details of the resource group.

>You can configure this parameter only if you have activated Resource Management.

If you do not configure this parameter, all rules of the Alibaba Cloud account are queried.

title.zh: 分页查询所有规则列表

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为20。

   > 单个阿里云账号下的所有RAM用户共享该阿里云账号的配额。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limits

You can call this API operation up to 20 times per second per account.

>  The RAM users of an Alibaba Cloud account share the quota of the account.
